messages:
Ivy Z: quick heads-up — we have an end-of-quarter cross-region perf run tomorrow 01:00 UTC. need 4x H100 in asia-south1 and 4x H100 in eu-west1 for sync tests. can procurement confirm vendor availability + firmware parity? :hourglass:
Ken P: are these reserved or short-term? reserved preferred for stable latency, but short-term rental ok if faster.
Ivy Z: reserved preferred. if reservation impossible, we can fallback to mixed pool but need to know perf delta.
Maya S: note — last month we saw RDMA driver mismatch between APAC vendor racks and eu-west fleet. NCCL allreduce blew up on large batch sizes. need firmware and driver versions to match.
infra-bot: quota check: org h100 quota eu-west1 = 12 used / 16 soft quota; asia-south1 = 2 used / 8 soft quota. requesting +8 will exceed eu-west1 soft quota. cross-region carve may be required.
procurement-bot: vendor note: partner has 10x H100 available across regions but requires PO + billing entity; can hold for 24h on provisional terms. awaiting PO submission.
oncall-joe: if vendor can't confirm, fallback idea: 6x H100 (eu) + 2x L40 (apac) + preemptible top-up in apac. we'll need to warm KV caches and pre-stage checkpoints. that combo kept similar perf in last test (within 8%).
Ken P: can someone post a quick terraform claim (draft) so procurement sees the exact request? include billing tag `qo-q3-perf`.
Maya S: also include driver/fwv fields in the PR: `driver_version = "520.61"` and `firmware_build = "h100-2024-04-12"` — vendor must confirm those or we add compatibility shim.
Ivy Z: good call. @procurement-bot please ask vendor to confirm firmware list and whether they can patch parity by T-12h.
procurement-bot: PO status: draft PO created (#PO-9021). finance approval pending. vendor reached out, asked for `billing_entity` value.
Ken P: billing_entity should be `rw-qo-prod`. add that to the PO and ping finance for expedited review.
Ivy Z: i'll open a draft PR now and tag the infra oncall. will include a small health-check script to run sanity after allocation.
Dave L: (joining) quick sample terraform we use for short reservations — paste into PR if helpful:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "qo_perf" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  model  = "h100"
  count  = 4
  duration_hours = 4
  tags = ["qo-q3-perf"]
}
```
Ken P: thanks — also add an `accept_fallback` boolean so procurement can approve an alternate mix automatically.
Ivy Z: will do. final asks for now:
- @procurement-bot expedite PO-9021 with billing_entity=rw-qo-prod
- vendor confirm firmware list by T-12h or we'll trigger fallback plan
- infra team to prepare quota carve or project carve if eu-west1 exceeds soft quota
- Maya to draft compatibility shim if vendor can't match driver versions
Maya S: i'll draft shim and perf notes — wont be instant but should buy us time.
procurement-bot: finance approved PO-9021 at 2024-05-08T18:12Z. vendor notified and holding 24h as requested.
Ivy Z: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll update the runbook and post the final reservation link once infra finishes the carve. :rocket:
